name: source-origins-ingress
description: The host sends a view source registration before its query answer, and the page keeps it until the answer seeds the source generations; the page then applies the kept registration, applies a later end, and reports a registration without a surface as an error event of its window.
reason: The case delivers the lifecycle notices of the host, and the Go producer runs no window and refuses a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
